Package arztis.econnector.rest

Class ConnectionDataHandler

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.rest.ConnectionDataHandler
public class ConnectionDataHandler
extends java.lang.Object
This class is a singleton that caches ConnectionData.
Author:
Anna Jungwirth

  • Method Details

    • getInstance

      public static ConnectionDataHandler getInstance()
      This method returns the instance of the class (Singleton).
      Returns:
      instance

    • addConnData

      public void addConnData​(ConnectionData connData)
      adds ConnectionData to a list of connection data. This list caches all registered users.
      Parameters:
      connData - Connection data of a single user, which is registered for ELGA and/or GINA

    • deleteConnData

      public void deleteConnData​(java.lang.String jwt)
      Deletes a certain connection data from the list of ConnectionData through the jwt.
      Parameters:
      jwt - of the user for which the connection data is to be deleted

    • overwriteConnDataInList

      public void overwriteConnDataInList​(ConnectionData connData)
      Method to overwrite one element of the list of ConnectionData. If there is an object in the list with the same user id as the user id of the parameter, the connection data in the list is overwritten by the parameter.
      Parameters:
      connData - ConnectionData

    • getConnectionDataWithUserToken

      public ConnectionData getConnectionDataWithUserToken​(java.lang.String jwt)
      This method returns the ConnectionData that has the same user id as specified in the parameter.
      Parameters:
      jwt - token of user, for which the connection data is required
      Returns:
      either the ConnectionData or null if no ConnectionData with the respective user ID is available
